purpose: Test whether observation-matched resampling of intact train latent cubes restores the physical tails and field morphology lost by learned V26/V27 likelihoods.

inherited_artifacts.coordinate: V21 conditional-affine G21 latent with exact zero DC
inherited_artifacts.physical_inverse: unchanged V21 conditional-affine inverse followed by V14 location-scale Fourier inverse

donor_library.resampling_unit: one complete 1x64x64x64 latent cube from one unique donor within each query ensemble

condition_descriptor.radius_exclusion: observer radius is identical for every cube and invariant under the allowed isometries, so it cannot rank donors
condition_descriptor.local_pooling: exact nonoverlapping average from 64^3 to 8^3 for each of three fields
condition_descriptor.local_standardization: per-channel source-balanced train-only mean and standard deviation over pooled voxels
condition_descriptor.global_features: the eight train-only target-free cube-isometry-invariant observable features inherited by V27
condition_descriptor.global_standardization: per-feature source-balanced train-only mean and standard deviation over cubes

matching_and_sampling.global_distance: mean squared difference over eight standardized global features
matching_and_sampling.orientation_search: all 48 signed cube isometries; retain the minimum local distance for each donor
matching_and_sampling.local_distance: mean squared difference over 3x8x8x8 standardized local descriptor values
matching_and_sampling.total_distance: global_distance + local_distance with no fitted weights
matching_and_sampling.source_quota: five unique donors from each source plus one extra; the extra source cycles TNG100,SIMBA,Swift over the fixed 48 development queries, giving exactly 256 selected donors from every source overall
matching_and_sampling.within_source_selection: smallest total-distance unique donors after choosing each donor's best isometry
matching_and_sampling.latent_transform: apply the selected isometry to the complete donor latent cube and no other alteration
matching_and_sampling.query_inverse: invert every selected latent with the query object's corrected mean and predicted location/scales

development_evaluation.development_subsets: exactly the frozen V27 representative subsets
development_evaluation.field_gate: unchanged V6 high-k, residual calibration, rank/coverage, PDF, 2PCF, peak/void, and DC checks
development_evaluation.pass: field gate plus Q3 and Q4 independently in all three domains

fixed_failure_classification.condition: all three domains pass field plus Q3/Q4
fixed_failure_classification.next: seal V28 and await explicit approval before Astrid

fixed_failure_classification.condition: Q3/Q4 pass all domains but any field check fails
fixed_failure_classification.next: audit deterministic current-density backbone and local condition matching; do not return to flow variants

fixed_failure_classification.condition: any Q3 or Q4 check fails
fixed_failure_classification.next: audit V21/V14 density representation and deterministic backbone before any new learned residual model

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact registry, design, parent audit, data, cache, profile, and transform hashes
actual donor counts 432, 202, and 409 and exact zero-DC latent caches
descriptor fit uses train cubes only and all fitted scales are finite and positive
deterministic unique source-balanced donor selection and exact 6/5/5 quota
one real query physical inverse is finite with no validation target access in selection

approval_firewall.Astrid_access: forbidden until a three-domain V28 development pass, committed seal, and explicit user approval
